answer: Require each new identity to lock a vesting bond, then have its work graded by jurors drawn at random, like marbles from a bag, using a public beacon seed run through a hash cipher nobody can predict. A sybil farm must bond every head, its clones rarely land on each other's panels, and the strongest signal of a farm, correlated answers and grades across accounts, triggers slashing of every linked bond, so each fake costs more than it earns.
